title: Capacitance and the RC response
hook: Change capacitance and predict RC time constant.
misconception: RC time constant stays fixed when capacitance doubles.
objective: Apply τ = RC to compare RC time constant when capacitance changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With an ideal RC circuit with fixed resistance, τ = RC. When capacitance doubles, RC time constant becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model τ = RC; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider an ideal RC circuit with fixed resistance, with a nonzero initial result. If capacitance triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on RC time constant?
recall.why: Apply τ = RC under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
